cohort: Pregnant women admitted with or who developed antepartum eclampsia in the antenatal ward of the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Deben Mahata Sadar Hospital, Purulia, West Bengal, and their newborns.
finding: Antepartum eclampsia resulted in adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes including preterm delivery, stillbirth, caesarean section, maternal complications, maternal mortality, low birth weight, low APGAR score, need for resuscitation, NICU admission, early neonatal complications, and early neonatal death.
